body: From the DM-171 review (orchestrator): docs/architecture.md still says metric_observations is schema v10 and does not mention v11 delivery identities, ticket budgets, `record_attempt_metrics`, `record_run_metrics`, `get_run_metrics` or `get_planned_baselines`. The worker and orchestrator skills and the server instructions do not teach metric reporting yet. In `src/mcp/tools/metrics.ts` the observations parameter says an agent-sourced human_rating fails with unauthorized, but it fails with invalid_input.
